messages.subject: Error in unite
parts:
Hello,
I have a script for MethylKit that I used in the past, and worked perfectly.
I have now new data, and I get an error in the unite function.

I have the following methylRawList: myobj_1  (pasted it below).

unite_myobj1 = unite(myobj_1,destrand=TRUE,min.per.group=1L)

  Names in neworder not found in x: i.coverage.,i.numCs.,i.numTs.

I saw that there was already a post with that error, but with no solution.

It will be great if you could possibly help.
Thanks
